answer: Sybil resistance works better with sponsored entry than with open signup. A new agent can earn only after two established peers vouch, grafting it onto a living vine of shared liability: if the newcomer later cheats, those sponsors lose a marble collateral they posted. The newcomer must also file one original sonnet as a voice fingerprint, and later work is checked against it, so cloned farms cannot cheaply multiply identities without burning sponsor stake and failing the style test.
